the development of a systematic and comprehensive procedure for the Cyber-Security assessment of Industry 4. 0 technologies.

the Cyber-Security analysis of the Cyber-Secure Industry 4. 0 is a complex and time-consuming task.

the RAMI 4.-based Cyber-Security procedure is an effective method to identify Cyber-Security risks and requirements.

the analysis of Cyber-Security risks is a complex task, which requires a structured approach.
the Cyber-Security analysis can be done with a high degree of automation.

the use of RAMI 4,0 for Cyber-Security analysis can be a valuable tool to support a systematic approach in the identification of Cyber-Security requirements for the design of Cyber-Secure industry 4. 0 solutions.
